ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows a dominant high-intensity (white/light grey) central region covering roughly 75% of the surface area, contrasted by low-intensity (dark grey/black) peripheral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial regions exhibit contiguous high-intensity light-grey pixels. Dark pigmentation blobs are localized at the distal tips of both lobes and in a thin band along the trailing edge. Sparse, low-contrast dark mottling is present in the medial-lower visible region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Median notch is a V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 35-40 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of roughly 12% relative to the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits a high-frequency, irregular serration map; approximately 12 distinct peaks and valleys are identifiable along the continuous boundary, with higher amplitude irregularities concentrated on the distal right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe sweep follows a convex trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered points with a slight posterior curvature.
